@import "./fonts.css"; /* FlowCode local fonts */
/*
 * Design tokens: the only place raw values live. Components consume var(--…) tokens.
 * To add a value, extend this file (extend_tokens workflow); never inline raw colors or sizes in components.
 *
 * How to use them (every screen follows these, so the app looks like one product):
 *  - Accent (--color-accent) is for the one main action per screen, links, the current navigation item and focus. Nothing else.
 *  - Color follows 60/30/10: neutrals (bg, surface) cover about 60%; the secondary covers about 30% (supporting
 *    areas: tinted panels with --color-secondary-surface and --color-secondary-border, secondary buttons, tags and
 *    filters with --color-secondary / --color-on-secondary); the accent stays at about 10%. The secondary is traced
 *    from the accent by a colour harmony, so the two belong together.
 *  - Success and danger colors are for status only (saved, done, error, delete). Never decoration.
 *  - Cards and panels use the surface color on the page background; wells, tracks and hover use surface-sunken.
 *  - Content uses the text color; descriptions, hints and labels use text-muted.
 *  - Spacing runs from space-1 to space-9 on an 8px rhythm (space-3 is a 4px half-step); space-8 and space-9 separate page sections. Related things sit closer than unrelated ones.
 *  - Radius: radius-sm for inputs and badges, radius-md for buttons, radius-lg for cards. Never mix in others.
 *  - Controls share the control-sm/md/lg/xl heights (with matching control-pad-* and control-text-*), so buttons,
 *    inputs and selects line up.
 *  - Surfaces: cards, panels and controls are drawn only with the surface tokens (border, shadow, blur, radius),
 *    so a different surface style restyles every screen at once.
 *  - States: hover lifts by hover-lift, pressing scales to press-scale, disabled fades to disabled-opacity,
 *    and keyboard focus always shows the focus ring.
 */
:root {
  /* Color — semantic roles */
  --color-bg: #FAFAF5;
  --color-surface: #ffffff;
  --color-surface-sunken: #e7ede6;
  --color-text: #141a13;
  --color-text-muted: #686e67;
  --color-border: #d3dad2;
  --color-border-strong: #828881;
  --color-accent: #15803d;
  --color-accent-hover: #07672e;
  --color-on-accent: #ffffff;
  --color-focus: #3b9d58;
  --color-danger: #aa4a36;
  --color-danger-surface: #fff4f2;
  --color-success: #15803d;
  --color-warning: #8b640a;
  /* Secondary (the 30%): analogous (+30°) to the accent, calmer than it */
  --color-secondary: #166534;
  --color-secondary-hover: #0b5328;
  --color-on-secondary: #ffffff;
  --color-secondary-surface: #e1f7e5;
  --color-secondary-border: #6c9575;

  /* Type */
  --font-sans: "Work Sans", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;
  --font-display: "Fraunces", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;
  --font-mono: "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, "Cascadia Mono", Consolas, monospace;
  --text-xs: 0.75rem;
  --text-sm: 0.875rem;
  --text-md: 1rem;
  --text-lg: 1.25rem;
  --text-xl: 1.75rem;
  --text-2xl: 2.5rem;
  --text-3xl: clamp(2.75rem, 6vw, 4rem);
  --leading-tight: 1.15;
  --leading-snug: 1.3;
  --leading-normal: 1.5;
  --leading-relaxed: 1.6;
  --tracking-tight: -0.02em;
  --tracking-wide: 0.04em;
  --measure: 68ch;
  --weight-regular: 400;
  --weight-medium: 550;
  --weight-semibold: 600;
  --weight-bold: 700;

  /* Type levels (Styles → Design → Typography): each heading level and body text has its own size, weight and line
     height, starting from the scale above. Small and caption text use --text-sm and --text-xs. */
  --type-display-size: var(--text-3xl);
  --type-display-weight: var(--heading-weight);
  --type-display-leading: var(--leading-tight);
  --type-h1-size: var(--text-2xl);
  --type-h1-weight: var(--heading-weight);
  --type-h1-leading: var(--leading-tight);
  --type-h2-size: var(--text-lg);
  --type-h2-weight: var(--weight-semibold);
  --type-h2-leading: var(--leading-snug);
  --type-h3-size: var(--text-md);
  --type-h3-weight: var(--weight-semibold);
  --type-h3-leading: var(--leading-snug);
  --type-body-size: var(--text-md);
  --type-body-weight: var(--weight-regular);
  --type-body-leading: var(--leading-normal);

  /* Space (4px scale) */
  --space-1: 0.25rem;
  --space-2: 0.5rem;
  --space-3: 0.75rem;
  --space-4: 1rem;
  --space-5: 1.5rem;
  --space-6: 2rem;
  --space-7: 3rem;
  --space-8: 4rem;
  --space-9: 6rem;

  /* Shape — radius never exceeds 10px */
  --radius-sm: 4px;
  --radius-md: 6px;
  --radius-lg: 8px;
  --radius-xl: 10px;
  --border-width: 1px;
  --focus-ring: 0 0 0 3px var(--color-focus);

  /* Controls and states */
  /* Control and button sizes (CSSVibes' button sizes: 32 / 40 / 48 / 56px, padding 16–28px, text 13–18px) */
  --control-sm: 2rem;
  --control-md: 2.5rem;
  --control-lg: 3rem;
  --control-xl: 3.5rem;
  --control-pad-sm: 1rem;
  --control-pad-md: 1.25rem;
  --control-pad-lg: 1.5rem;
  --control-pad-xl: 1.75rem;
  --control-text-sm: 0.8125rem;
  --control-text-md: 0.875rem;
  --control-text-lg: 1rem;
  --control-text-xl: 1.125rem;
  --hover-lift: -1px;
  --press-scale: 0.98;
  --disabled-opacity: 0.55;

  /* Surface style: flat (how cards, panels, buttons and inputs are drawn; set by the chosen vibe) */
  --surface-bg: var(--color-surface);
  --surface-border: var(--border-width) solid var(--color-border);
  --surface-shadow: none;
  --surface-shadow-hover: 0 6px 20px -12px color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-text) 35%, transparent);
  --surface-blur: none;
  --surface-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  --control-radius: var(--radius-md);
  --control-border: var(--border-width) solid var(--color-border-strong);
  --control-shadow: none;
  --control-shadow-hover: none;
  --header-bg: var(--color-surface);
  --page-backdrop: none;
  --page-fill: var(--color-bg); /* a decorative section background's fill: transparent where the surface paints a backdrop */
  --heading-weight: var(--weight-bold);
  /* More surface-style traits (a style may set any; these defaults are the flat look; "initial" = not set) */
  --control-bg: var(--color-surface);
  --accent-bg: var(--color-accent);
  --control-edge: initial;
  --surface-edge: initial;
  --control-shadow-active: var(--control-shadow-hover);
  --control-shadow-focus: var(--focus-ring);
  --well-shadow: var(--control-shadow);
  --surface-shadow-selected: 0 0 0 1px var(--color-accent);
  --surface-shadow-overlay: initial;
  --surface-radius-sm: var(--radius-md);
  --control-radius-sm: var(--radius-sm);
  --pill-radius: 999px;
  --field-radius: min(var(--control-radius), 12px); /* text boxes: never a pill, never over 12px */
  --edge-width: var(--border-width);
  --overlay-border: initial;
  --tag-tilt: 0deg;
  --hover-shift: none;
  --press-shift: none;

  /* Layout & motion */
  --content-max: 72rem;
  --breakpoint-wide: 900px;
  --duration-fast: 120ms;
  --easing: cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1);
  /* Motion (Styles → Tokens → motion): micro-animations give every action immediate feedback. Instant for presses,
     fast for hovers and toggles, base for things appearing, slow for screens. Reduced motion turns all of it off. */
  --duration-instant: 80ms;
  --duration-base: 200ms;
  --duration-slow: 320ms;
  --ease-out: cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
  --ease-spring: cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1);
  --enter-distance: 8px;
  --stagger: 40ms;

  /* FlowCode palette: brand, neutral and status ramps (Styles → Design → Colours). Edited there. */
  --brand-primary-50: #ecfcee;
